title: strobilanthes quadrifaria
intro: Strobilanthes quadrifaria, commonly known as the "Four-leaf Acanthus", is a flowering plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain, swelling, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of S. quadrifaria are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and act as an anti-hemorrhagic agent. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
